description_en: Retrieves the chart of test results for a custom rule

name: DescribeCustomizeRuleTestHistogram

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom rule
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts in your enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图

parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Management Hub of threat analysis is located. Select the region of the Management Hub based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China

威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
